item.title: Ask HN: Are You Preparing for the Singularity
item.summary: At this point it seems pretty clear that we are in the midst of the Singularity right now. Noteworthy unsolved math problems are being solved at an alarming rate. Agent swarms have executed hacks at the level of nation state actors. Depending on the domain, frontier AI models demonstrate intelligence at human levels or above. And capabilities are improving at a rapid rate at every level of the stack with no signs of slowing down. At this point it feels like we are witnessing one of the most significant events in world history. The risks and downsides are obviously catastrophic in nature. Job losses being among the potentially milder issues coming up. What are people doing to prepare for the transformations that are coming?
